meta.name: V8 engine
meta.description: A four-stroke v8 engine driven from one crankshaft: pistons, cams, valves and firing pulses all stay in sync.

parts.label: Cylinder block
parts.description: Cast housing that holds the cylinders, main bearings and coolant passages.

parts.label: Oil pan
parts.description: Sump that collects oil drained from the bearings; the pump draws from it.

parts.label: Crankshaft
parts.description: Turns the pistons’ up-and-down motion into rotation. Everything else is timed from it.

parts.label: Crank throw 1
parts.description: Counterweighted web that offsets the crank pin from the main journal.

parts.label: Crank pin 1
parts.description: Journal the connecting rods ride on, swinging around the crank axis.

parts.label: Crank throw 2
parts.description: Counterweighted web that offsets the crank pin from the main journal.

parts.label: Crank pin 2
parts.description: Journal the connecting rods ride on, swinging around the crank axis.

parts.label: Crank throw 3
parts.description: Counterweighted web that offsets the crank pin from the main journal.

parts.label: Crank pin 3
parts.description: Journal the connecting rods ride on, swinging around the crank axis.

parts.label: Crank throw 4
parts.description: Counterweighted web that offsets the crank pin from the main journal.

parts.label: Crank pin 4
parts.description: Journal the connecting rods ride on, swinging around the crank axis.

parts.label: Flywheel
parts.description: Heavy ring gear that smooths power pulses; the starter meshes with its teeth.

parts.label: Crank sprocket
parts.description: Drives the timing chain; it has half the teeth of the cam sprocket.

parts.label: Camshaft
parts.description: Turns at exactly half crank speed so each valve opens once per four-stroke cycle.

parts.label: Cam sprocket
parts.description: Twice the crank sprocket’s teeth: the 2:1 reduction of a four-stroke.

parts.label: Cylinder 1
parts.description: Bored sleeve the piston slides in; its walls seal the combustion gases.

parts.label: Piston 1
parts.description: Driven down by combustion pressure; follows the crank pin through the connecting rod.

parts.label: Piston rings 1
parts.description: Spring-steel rings that seal compression and scrape oil off the bore.

parts.label: Connecting rod 1
parts.description: Links piston to crank pin; its swing turns linear force into torque.

parts.label: Combustion chamber 1
parts.description: Where the compressed charge burns; the flash shows each cylinder’s power stroke in firing order.

parts.label: Spark plug 1
parts.description: Fires a spark just before top dead centre to light the mixture.

parts.label: Intake valve 1
parts.description: Opens to let fresh air-fuel charge in on the intake stroke.

parts.label: Intake valve spring 1
parts.description: Helical spring that snaps the valve shut when the cam lobe passes.

parts.label: Exhaust valve 1
parts.description: Opens near the end of the power stroke to let burned gas out.

parts.label: Exhaust valve spring 1
parts.description: Helical spring that snaps the valve shut when the cam lobe passes.
